caption:
Costa Rica holds nearly 5 percent of global biodiversity across less than 0.1 percent of the planet's land area.

As trails descend from high cloud forest to humid valleys, the vegetation changes every 2 hours of movement. Stunted mountain plants give way to dense moss and flowering understory. Altitude dictates every ecosystem along the route.
